title: Data-centre exit: how should we move to the cloud?
question: Our co-located data-centre contract ends in 14 months. Which migration strategy should we commit to?
context: Mid-size B2B SaaS, 40 services, 2 legacy monoliths, 18 engineers on platform work. Hosting cost is 22% of revenue and the board wants it under 15% within two years.
constraints: Zero customer-facing downtime longer than 30 minutes

options.title: Lift and shift everything to IaaS
options.description: Move VMs as-is in one programme, optimise later.

options.title: Phased re-platform onto managed services
options.description: Containerise services in waves, move databases to managed offerings, retire the monoliths last.

options.title: Rewrite as cloud-native microservices
options.description: Freeze features for a year and rebuild the product on serverless.
